title: Spectral Portal Ritual
description: A surreal psychedelic scene features a large melting blue ghost with wide eyes standing on a circular rug, pointing toward a swirling blue portal. A hooded figure in red and purple with dripping paint stands beside the portal, while three colorful horses (green, blue, and orange) run across a higher stone platform surrounded by arches with swirling vortex patterns, magical flowers, and potion bottles.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic painting of a large melting blue ghost with wide eyes standing on a patterned rug and pointing at a swirling blue portal. A hooded figure in dripping red and purple robes stands beside the portal. In the background, a green horse, blue horse, and orange horse gallop across a higher stone level framed by three arched windows showing swirling colorful vortexes. Scattered potion bottles, magical flowers, open books, and paint drips throughout the scene on a checkered floor.
